title: 第15章 惊天大案第16章 进宫
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
“好刀！”
他由衷地感叹道。
这柄血刀不仅锋利无比，更透着一股难以言喻的杀意，仿佛是为战场而生，为杀戮而来。
江辰知道，这柄血刀绝非凡品，定能在他未来的修炼之路上发挥巨大的作用。
他轻轻地抚摸着刀身，感受着那份来自远古的寒意。
……
一夜无话。
第二天清晨，当第一缕阳光穿透云层，洒在镇抚司的青石板上时，江辰已经整理好衣衫，大摇大摆地走进了锦衣卫中。
他的步伐稳健而自信，仿佛昨晚发生的一切都没有对他产生任何影响。
刚到镇抚司门口，江辰就敏锐地察觉到了一股不同寻常的气氛。
他抬头望去，只见青龙使孟望津手下的三名千户、九名副千户以及二十七名百户，皆神色凝重地来到了东镇抚司的门口。
他们身着锦衣卫特有的飞鱼服，腰佩绣春刀，身形挺拔如松，气势汹汹如狼。
这些锦衣卫高手的到来，无疑让整个镇抚司的气氛变得更加紧张。
江辰心中暗自思量，这些锦衣卫高手齐聚一堂，究竟是为了何事？
难道与昨晚的密信有关？
他静静地站在一旁，观察着这些人的举动。
只见他们低声交谈，偶尔有人抬头望向远方，似乎在等待着什么重要的消息。
东镇抚司的广场，宽广无垠，仿佛一片辽阔的平原，足以容纳上万人同时聚集而不显拥挤。
广场四周，古木参天，青石铺地，显得庄严肃穆。
此时，阳光透过云层，斑驳地洒在广场上，为这即将到来的重要时刻增添了几分庄重。

孟望津，一身锦衣卫的飞鱼服穿在身上，更显得他英姿飒爽，气势非凡。
他站在高处，俯瞰着整个广场，神色严肃，表情阴寒万分，仿佛冬日里的寒风，让人不寒而栗。
那双深邃的眼眸中，闪烁着愤怒的神色，显然是动了真怒，才会如此失态。
在他的身后，是一面巨大的锦旗，上面绣着青龙图腾，栩栩如生，仿佛随时都会腾空而起，翱翔于九天之上。
这面锦旗，是东锦衣卫的象征。
时间缓缓流逝，大约一盏茶的功夫过后，东镇抚司所有小旗以上的锦衣卫，绝大多数都已经到达了现场。
他们身着统一的飞鱼服，腰佩锋利的绣春刀，步伐整齐划一，气势如虹。
孟望津站在高处，目光如炬，扫视着下方密密麻麻的锦衣卫，也不管人有没有齐，直接开口，声音沉稳而有力，穿透了喧嚣的人群，回荡在广阔的东镇抚司广场上：“昨天，玉灵公主在皇宫之中被人绑架了，此事已经惊动了陛下。”
他的语气中带着一丝不容置疑的威严，每一个字都像是重锤，敲击在众人的心上。
广场上的锦衣卫们闻言，皆是神色一凛，目光中流露出惊讶之色。
“陛下震怒，已经下令。”
孟望津的声音更加低沉，却更加有力：“锦衣卫务必在天黑之前追回玉灵公主，不得有误。
否则，锦衣卫中所有人今年的俸禄减半，以示惩戒。”
此话一出，众人脸上皆是露出了一丝惊诧之色。
玉灵公主，当今圣上最疼爱的一个女儿，自幼便集万千宠爱于一身。
她的容颜倾城，气质高贵，宛如天上的仙子落入凡尘，让人一见难忘。
明皇对她的保护，可以说是密不透风。
content_en:
"Good knife!"
He sighed sincerely.
This bloody knife is not only extremely sharp, but also contains an indescribable killing intent, as if it was born for the battlefield and came for killing.
Jiang Chen knew that this bloody sword was absolutely extraordinary and would definitely play a huge role in his future cultivation path.
He gently stroked the blade, feeling the chill from ancient times.
…
A night of silence.
In the early morning of the next day, when the first ray of sunlight penetrated the clouds and shone on the bluestone of Zhenfusi, Jiang Chen had already arranged his clothes and walked into the Jinyi Guards in a swaggering manner.
His steps were steady and confident, as if nothing that happened last night had any impact on him.
As soon as he arrived at the gate of Zhenfu Division, Jiang Chen was keenly aware of an unusual atmosphere.
He looked up and saw three Qianhu, nine deputy Qianhu and twenty-seven Baihu under Qinglong envoy Meng Wangjin, all arriving at the gate of Fusi in Dongzhen with solemn expressions.
They were dressed in Jinyiwei's unique flying fish uniforms, with embroidered spring knives on their waists. Their bodies were as tall and straight as pine trees, and their aura was as menacing as wolves.
The arrival of these Jinyiwei masters undoubtedly made the atmosphere in the entire Zhenfu Division more tense.
Jiang Chen secretly thought to himself, what is the purpose of these Jinyiwei masters gathering together?
Could it be related to the secret message last night?
He stood quietly and observed the actions of these people.
I saw them talking in low voices, and occasionally someone looked up into the distance, as if waiting for some important news.
The square in Dongzhen Fusi is vast and boundless, like a vast plain, enough to accommodate tens of thousands of people gathering at the same time without being crowded.
Around the square, there are towering ancient trees and bluestone pavement, making it look solemn and solemn.
At this time, the sun shines through the clouds and dappled the square, adding a bit of solemnity to this upcoming important moment.
Meng Wangjin, wearing the Feiyu uniform of Jin Yiwei, made him even more heroic and heroic.
He stood on a high place, overlooking the entire square, with a serious expression and a cold expression, like the cold wind in winter, which made people shudder.
There was an angry look in those deep eyes, and it was obvious that he was really angry, and that was why he lost his composure.
Behind him is a huge silk flag with a green dragon totem embroidered on it. It is lifelike, as if it will rise into the sky at any time and soar above the nine heavens.
This banner is the symbol of Dongjin Yiwei.
Time passed slowly, and after about a cup of tea, most of the imperial guards above the small flag in Dongzhen Fusi had arrived at the scene.
They wore uniform Feiyu uniforms and carried sharp embroidered spring knives at their waists. Their steps were uniform and their momentum was like a rainbow.
Meng Wangjin stood at a high place, his eyes like torches, scanning the densely packed Jinyi guards below. Regardless of whether there were people present, he spoke directly. His voice was calm and powerful, which penetrated the noisy crowd and echoed in the vast Fusi Square of Dongzhen: "Yesterday, Princess Yuling was kidnapped in the palace. This matter has alarmed His Majesty."
There was a trace of unquestionable majesty in his tone, and every word was like a heavy hammer, hitting everyone's hearts.
When the Jinyi guards in the square heard this, they all looked stern, with surprise in their eyes.
"Your Majesty is furious and has given the order."
Meng Wangjin's voice was deeper, but more powerful: "The Jinyi Guards must recover Princess Yuling before dark, and there must be no mistakes.
Otherwise, the salary of everyone in Jinyiwei will be halved this year as punishment. "
As soon as these words came out, everyone's faces showed a look of surprise.
Princess Yuling, the most beloved daughter of the current Holy Emperor, has been loved by thousands of people since she was a child.
Her appearance is stunning and her temperament is noble. She is like a fairy from heaven falling into the mortal world, making her unforgettable at first sight.
Emperor Ming's protection for her can be said to be airtight.
